npc_intro.player_text: You look like a man who knows this place.

npc_identity.text: A navigator. I know the Baltic coasts and the old roads.

mock_outfit.text: You must have a lot of personality.

ask_if_comedian.text: Are you a comedian by any chance, Navigator?

leave.text: I will leave you to it.

npc_silent_stare.player_text: You must have a lot of personality.
npc_silent_stare.text: Who do you think you are?

leave.text: Then I shall leave you to your honor.

npc_final_insult.text: You insulted me for the last time.

npc_hendrik_identity.text: No, I am not. And the name is Hendrik.

leave.text: I will leave you to it.

npc_ask_name.text: Interesting that you ask. Before we discuss business, what is your name?

npc_ink_request.text: Good, Rebane. I have run out of ink, and without ink my maps are useless. Bring me some, and perhaps I will decide you are worth my time.

accept_ink_quest.text: I will find ink for you.

npc_after_identity.text: Back again? If you want a navigator's time, show me that you can notice what is needed.

npc_waiting_for_ink.text: Bring me ink for my maps, Rebane. Then we can discuss opportunities.

give_ink.text: Here is the ink you asked for.

npc_ink_thanks.player_text: About the ink for your charts...
npc_ink_thanks.text: Just what I needed. Here is your reward: a map of the trading route from Tallinn to Tartu. Your first journey starts here.

lady_hendrik.text: Oh, I see you got acquainted with Hendrik. What did he tell you?

explain_ink.text: He needs ink. I am new here; where should I look?

lady_directions.player_text: Hendrik sent me to find ink.
lady_directions.text: Ink is expensive here. Try asking the guard by the city gate. He might know where to look.

thank_lady.text: Thank you. I will ask him.

lady_after_ink.text: Then you are finding your way around already.

guard_idle.text: Keep the gate clear, traveller. If you need directions, ask someone in the square first.

guard_forest.player_text: Where can I find ink around here?
guard_forest.text: Ink? Could not say. Try outside the walls, across the river and into the forest, if you know what to look for. You may pass.

follow_directions.text: Thank you. I will go through the gate.

mushroom_idle.text: Everything in this forest moves eventually.

mushroom_ink.player_text: I need black ink. Does the big fellow know where to find it?
mushroom_ink.text: Metsavana is busy. I do the talking. See that inkcap beside me? Its black goo is ready to write with. You could bottle it. Or perhaps you were thinking of licking it?

collect_ink.text: Collect the black goo in my bottle.

need_bottle.text: I have nothing to carry it in.

mushroom_need_bottle.player_text: Could I put it in a cup?
mushroom_need_bottle.text: A bottle with a stopper would be wiser. Someone in town must have emptied one by now.

mushroom_collected.text: Keep the stopper in. Hendrik needs ink on his maps, not on your insides.

inkcap_choices.player_text: This mushroom is oozing black liquid.
inkcap_choices.text: The talking mushroom calls it ink. It looks ready to bottle.

collect_ink.text: Collect the goo in my bottle.

knife_mushroom_intro.text: Locals. Baskets. Smiling locals with baskets. Tell me... do you like eating mushrooms?

no.text: No. I prefer my food less conversational.

knife_mushroom_relief.player_text: I am not here to pick you.
knife_mushroom_relief.text: Good. Neither am I. We understand each other.

wise_mushroom_intro.text: Only when necessary. Apparently this is one of those occasions.

ask_knife.text: Why does that mushroom have a knife?

leave.text: I will leave you in peace.

wise_mushroom_metsavana.text: In a trance. The gnomes keep him clean and fed. An excellent arrangement, unless you are a gnome.

ask_gnomes.text: What do the gnomes get out of it?

wise_mushroom_gnomes.player_text: Do they get anything in return?
wise_mushroom_gnomes.text: Wisdom. Shelter. The occasional root to trip over. He calls it a benefits package.

wise_mushroom_ink.text: Touch the purple mushroom beside me. One bottle of ink, no appointment. Writing material, not lunch. An important distinction.

leave.text: Purple mushroom. Touch. No licking. Understood.

wise_mushroom_knife.text: People arrive with baskets. He has developed a pointed objection. Avoid discussing dinner.

back.text: I will choose my words carefully.

wise_mushroom_after_ink.text: Then take it to Hendrik. Put it on paper. Humans have needed that clarified before.

leave.text: Ink on paper. I can manage that.

purple_mushroom_silent.text: The purple mushroom quietly wobbles. The wise mushroom gestures for you to touch it.

old_sailor_look.text: An old sailor stands before me.

old_sailor_touch.text: I should keep my hands to myself.

walking_area_look.text: The road continues through the town square.

glowing_gem_look.text: A small gem pulses with an unnatural light.

glowing_gem_touch.text: The gem feels warm beneath my fingers.

clothes_trader_look.text: A clothes trader watches the square from behind an elaborate mask.

clothes_trader_touch.text: I should keep my hands off the trader's wares.

clothes_trader_talk.text: The clothes trader stares back at me without saying a word.

clothes_trader_walk.text: I can't walk through the clothes trader.

female_clothes_trader_look.text: A woman in traditional dress tends the clothes stall.

female_clothes_trader_touch.text: I should keep my hands off the trader's wares.

female_clothes_trader_talk.text: The clothes trader watches me quietly without saying a word.

female_clothes_trader_walk.text: I can't walk through the clothes trader.

generic_talk.text: There is no one to talk to.

ink_bottle_look.text: A bottle of dark ink. It might be useful for drawing charts.

city_exit_locked.text: I should speak to Hendrik, ask the lady for directions, and get the guard's permission first.

city_guard_look.text: A guard keeps watch beside the city gate.

empty_bottle_look.text: An empty bottle beside the drunken count. It could hold ink.

sleeping_drunk_look.text: A count, thoroughly drunk in the street beside the city gates. His bottle is empty.

sleeping_drunk_talk.text: “...õh... hrr... ...” The count slurs something in Livonian, then loses his train of thought.

metsavana_silent.text: Metsavana does not reply. The gnomes keep scraping. A nearby mushroom seems to be watching me.

metsavana_look.text: Gnomes are carefully scraping and cleaning the huge forest figure.

mushroom_look.text: A mushroom that looks as though it has something to say.

inkcap_look.text: A mushroom oozes a thick black liquid.

gnome_look.text: A gnome scrapes away, pausing now and then to catch his breath.

mushroom_poisoned.text: The goo is poisonous. You turn green and collapse. Click to retry before tasting it; your quest progress is safe.

exit_look.text: The road continues. Walk here to travel.

knife_mushroom_look.text: A small mushroom with a knife and a very large trust issue.

knife_mushroom_touch.text: He tightens his grip on the knife. Touching him seems unwise.

inkcap_collected.text: You collect a bottle of ink from the purple mushroom. Hendrik can use this.

inkcap_already_collected.text: You already collected the ink. The mushroom is not a refill station.

inventory.no_tasks:

inventory.use_hint: Touch the person or object you want to use this item on. Choose another HUD action to cancel.
inventory.cannot_talk: It does not have much to say.
inventory.click_hint: Choose an action in the HUD, then click an item.

task_scroll.name: Tasks
task_scroll.look: A yellow scroll containing my current tasks.
task_scroll.touch: I unroll the scroll and read my tasks.

ink_bottle.name: Ink
ink_bottle.look: A bottle of dark ink. Hendrik needs this for his charts.
ink_bottle.touch: The stopper is firmly in place.

empty_bottle.name: Empty bottle
empty_bottle.look: An empty bottle from beside the drunken count at the city gates. It could hold ink.
empty_bottle.touch: I could fill this with the black mushroom goo.

tartu_route_map.name: Tallinn-Tartu route
tartu_route_map.look: Hendrik's map of the trading route from Tallinn to Tartu. My first route!
tartu_route_map.touch: I carefully unfold the map. The road leads to Tartu.

navigator_ink.title: Ink for Hendrik
navigator_ink.description: Find a container, find ink, and bring it to Hendrik.
navigator_ink.completed: Hendrik takes the ink and gives me the Tallinn-Tartu trading-route map. Demo complete!
